description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the AuthorizationSubject interface, representing an authorization subject with a unique ID, including factory methods, equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableAuthorizationSubject
classes.description: An immutable class implementing AuthorizationSubject, encapsulating an ID with validation and standard object methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableAuthorizationSubject with validation for null and empty ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the AuthorizationSubject.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare ImmutableAuthorizationSubject instances based on ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash code based on ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the AuthorizationSubject, which is its ID.
